name: ANA LETÍCIA ALVES CLAUDIANO
title: Senior Full Stack & DevOps Engineer
summary: Senior Full Stack & DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of software engineering experience architecting scalable web applications (TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL) and automated cloud infrastructure (AWS, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes). Proven track record leading core platform delivery in mission-critical environments, establishing robust CI/CD automation with GitHub Actions, containerizing microservices, and reducing deployment times while maintaining 99.9% uptime. Bilingual communicator (C1+ English) experienced in agile, cross-functional, and US-distributed teams.

experience.role: Senior Full Stack & DevOps Engineer (Platform Lead)
bullets: Architect and lead end-to-end platform delivery for core EdTech services, developing high-performance full-stack systems with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Node.js/Python microservices.
Spearhead DevOps automation by designing and managing production CI/CD workflows with GitHub Actions and Docker, accelerating release frequency by 45% with zero-downtime deployments on AWS.
Containerize services and standardize staging and production cloud environments, enforcing environment parity and maintaining 99.9% platform availability across tens of thousands of active users.
Optimize backend data throughput and query execution across PostgreSQL and Redis caching layers, slashing median API response latencies from 420ms to under 110ms.
Integrate robust automated testing suites (Playwright, Vitest) and continuous monitoring pipelines, eliminating behavioral regressions and ensuring production stability.
Owned web application lifecycles from architecture design to production release, making critical engineering decisions on distributed system scalability and user experience.
Engineered scalable RESTful APIs and asynchronous webhook processors in Python and Node.js, ensuring reliable data synchronization across multi-tenant PostgreSQL databases.
Built automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions and Docker, establishing automated linting, test validation (Jest, Playwright), and consistent cloud deployments.

Engineered reusable frontend design systems and component libraries ([Live Demo](https://designsystemeadedo-git-202612-ana-leticias-projects-198dfb27.vercel.app/)) using React and Tailwind CSS, speeding up cross-squad feature delivery by 35%.
Developed automated Python pipelines and validation workflows to process, sanitize, and analyze large-scale scientific datasets with deterministic accuracy.
Constructed automated data validation rubrics and quality evaluation scripts to assess dataset integrity and model consistency for public decision-makers.
Maintained version-controlled repositories and reproducible CI/CD execution environments across an agile research team.
